Slight smudging and lack of sharp micro-texture in the wood grain near the metal keys. The transition between wood and metal lacks the crisp edge definition expected in high-resolution photography.
The connection between the metal bocal and the wood appears slightly fused or soft, lacking a clear mechanical joint or seal. It looks like it melts into the wood rather than being inserted.
